resources.string: Connect this phone to your PC
In AutoFileSync on the PC, open File → Connect phone… and scan the code that appears.
Point the camera at the code on the PC screen.
Without the camera the code cannot be scanned. You can also open the link with the camera app.
This phone will then appear in AutoFileSync on the PC, where you set up what is synchronised.
PC not reachable: is it switched on and in the same Wi-Fi?
The PC no longer knows this phone. Connect it again.
No synchronisation set up yet. Set one up in AutoFileSync on the PC.
You change settings in AutoFileSync on the PC.
That is not an AutoFileSync code.
The code has expired. Open “Connect phone…” on the PC again.
PC not reachable: is it switched on and in the same Wi-Fi?
The PC did not present the expected certificate. Scan a fresh code.
The PC refused the code. Open “Connect phone…” on the PC again and scan the new code.
The PC is not waiting for a phone. Open “Connect phone…” on the PC first.
So that the PC can read and write the folders you set up, AutoFileSync needs access to all files on this phone.
Without access to all files the PC cannot synchronise this phone.
The file server on the phone could not be started.
Synchronised %1$s, %2$d errors – see the log on the PC
